name: fallTime
meaning: ticks of fall (g_dt); gravity speed = fallTime*1500>>12 capped at 1000; zeroed on floor contact

name: sliding
meaning: pos is inside slidingBox (x/z): slides at 400 u/s toward -z

name: collBox
meaning: model box 0, or box 1 when box 0 lacks flag 4 and there is more than 1 box; lift-height test and push roll

name: slidingBox
meaning: SLIDINGBOX, only if its id list holds exactly one box

name: launch
meaning: copy of the msg 0xC LaunchArc; t at +0xb0 (advanced by g_dtMs>>2), camera +0xb4, obj +0xb8, camParam +0xbc, flags +0xc0

name: carryYaw
meaning: yaw relative to the carrier while attached (msg 4), restored on drop

name: deathBoxes
meaning: zone list {boxes, count}: Scn_FindIdList(10 WAR_IDO_DEATHBOX) | count (+4): count for deathBoxes

name: baseModel
meaning: saved intact model, restored when leaving state 4

name: brokenModel
meaning: WAR_IDO_AROCHE5B (id list 0x58), swapped in by SetState(4)

name: iceBody
meaning: embedded ScnBody from WAR_IDO_AGLACON1 (only Lvl-06 exports it); drawn and collided while FLOATING; model at +0x114, pos at +0x118
